title: Descent of source images to a finite stage
statement: With [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions], suppose S is affine and D:I→Over T is a small cofiltered diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting. For every η∈A(c.pt), there exist i and η_i∈A(D_i) such that r_(c.π_i)(b_i(η_i)) = b_c(η). This concerns arbitrary source elements and has no survival or nonzero assumption.

source.place: Tags 0F07 (restriction square and limit condition) and 09Z1 (higher direct image continuity)

proof.text: The underlying affine-transition limit is quasi-compact (Mathlib Scheme.compactSpace_of_isLimit). Choose a stage using cofiltered nonemptiness: its affine limit projection implies that the limit is quasi-separated. Since S is affine, the structure maps of the stages and limit to S are quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

Use higher-image over-transition coherence to construct the functor K on I opposite, whose objects are the higher direct images of the pullbacks of F, and its canonical cocone B at the limit. Affine higher-image continuity says that B is colimiting after evaluation on every affine etale S-scheme. Affine colimit detection makes B a colimit cocone of sheaves on S.

Apply inverse image along p and the geometric stalk functor at x to B. Both left adjoints preserve colimits. The homology-commutation isomorphism for exact inverse image identifies the original source stalk with the resulting cocone point. Mathlib Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep gives a stage representative; transport it back through this isomorphism to obtain eta_i. This works for every integer degree, including negative degrees, without a separate vanishing argument.

Naturality of the inverse-image homology-commutation isomorphism conjugates the higher-image transition into the source restriction map. Combine baseChangeHomologyMap_comp_baseChangeTargetTransition with coefficient naturality, then apply the stalk functor. This identifies restriction of the stage base-change image with base change of the represented limit element; the representative equality gives the required equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09Z1 and 0F07; S1 sheaf-colimit realization with exact inverse-image homology comparison, 2026-10-14

mathlib_searches.results: Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_zero and ModuleCat.FilteredColimits.M.mk_surjective, M.mk_map, M.mk_eq; abstract criteria only, not the geometric realization. Loogle confirmed Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_zero.

Existing higherDirectImage_limit supplies stalk continuity for higher images, but not source inverse-image/homology identification or target pullback/coefficient identification. Existing target composition and base-change naturality supply the two proved compatibility lemmas. No canonical stalk wrappers or source-image descent/target-zero detection declarations found.

lean.statement: theorem baseChange_source_image_limit_descent (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone c)) (η : baseChangeSourceStalk Λ p g q F x c.pt) : ∃ (i : I) (ηi : baseChangeSourceStalk Λ p g q F x (D.obj i)), (baseChangeTargetStalkMap Λ p g q F x (c.π.app i)).hom ((baseChangeStalkMap Λ p g q F x (D.obj i)).hom ηi) = (baseChangeStalkMap Λ p g q F x c.pt).hom η
